youtube.title: Sort 1,000 Photos in 10 Minutes – Free App for Windows & Mac | SlimSort
youtube.description:
How to sort thousands of photos into folders – fast. SlimSort is a free photo sorter and photo organizer for Windows and Mac: one key press per photo moves it into the right folder.

⬇️ Free download: https://slimbitapps.github.io/SlimSort/
🌐 All apps: https://slimbitapps.github.io

Back from vacation with 2,000 photos in one folder? Phone backup full of random pictures? SlimSort makes sorting photos simple: give each target folder a key (1 = Family, 2 = Holiday, 3 = Nature …), look at each photo and press a key. The photo moves, the next one appears instantly. Most people sort about 1,000 photos in 10 minutes – much faster than dragging pictures into folders in File Explorer or Finder.

✅ Sort photos into folders with one key press
✅ Never overwrites files – unlimited undo (Ctrl+Z / Cmd+Z)
✅ Safe with NAS and network drives: copies are verified before the original is removed
✅ Burst photo detection: compares similar shots side by side and suggests the sharpest one (photo culling made easy)
✅ Overview mode with multi-select, multiple source folders
✅ JPG, PNG, HEIC, RAW (DNG, CR2, CR3, NEF, ARW …) and videos – Live Photos and sidecar files move along
✅ Light & dark design, English, German, French, Spanish, Italian
✅ 100 % free: no ads, no account, no subscription, no cloud – works offline

❓ FAQ
Is SlimSort really free? – Yes, completely free, no ads and no account.
Does it work on Windows 11 and macOS? – Yes, Windows 10/11 and macOS 12 or newer (Apple silicon and Intel).
Are my photos uploaded? – No. SlimSort works offline, your photos never leave your computer.
Can I use it with a NAS (Synology, QNAP …)? – Yes, target folders can be on network drives.

SlimSort is a hobby project by SlimBit Apps – small apps that do more and use less. Ideas or questions? Leave a comment or write to SlimBitApps@gmail.com
